title: Where CI-only check scripts live
context: New stdlib CI check scripts (CI-3 forbidden content, CI-6 secrets, CI-10 budget, CI-13 scenario coverage) and the release version-bump helper need a home. shared/scripts/ is copied into the shipped dist (PLG-9/PLG-10), so CI-only tooling placed there would ship to users and could import non-stdlib (violates RULE-24). A new tests/ci/ dir plus build/bump_version.py keeps CI tooling out of the shipped plugin.

options.label: New tests/ci/ dir + build/bump_version.py (CI tooling never ships)
Put them under shared/scripts/ (would ship into dist)

rationale: CI tooling must not ship into dist (PLG-9/10, RULE-24); tests/ci/ + build/bump_version.py keeps it out
